name: Hermansky-Pudlak Syndrome Type 9

criteria.description: Presence of oculocutaneous albinism with hypopigmentation of skin, hair, and eyes
Bleeding diathesis due to platelet storage pool deficiency
Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in the AP3D1 gene
Evidence of pulmonary fibrosis or interstitial lung disease
Presence of granulomatous inflammation on histopathology

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of oculocutaneous albinism, bleeding diathesis, and genetic confirmation of AP3D1 mutations
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis may be supported by pulmonary findings and histopathology but these are not mandatory.

pathognomonic.notes: Characteristic hypopigmentation of skin, hair, and eyes
searchTerms: very light skin and hair color
lack of pigment in skin and eyes
pale skin and hair from pigment loss

pathognomonic.symptomName: Platelet storage pool deficiency causing bleeding diathesis
pathognomonic.notes: Prolonged bleeding time despite normal platelet count

common.notes: Due to ocular hypopigmentation and foveal hypoplasia
searchTerms: involuntary eye movements and blurry vision

common.notes: Light sensitivity due to iris transillumination

common.symptomName: Pulmonary fibrosis or interstitial lung disease
common.notes: Progressive lung involvement often in adolescence or adulthood
searchTerms: lung scarring or interstitial lung disease
repeated infections due to weak immunity

occasional.notes: Enlargement of liver and spleen in some cases

laboratory: Prolonged bleeding time with normal platelet count
Absent or reduced platelet dense granules on electron microscopy
imaging: Chest X-ray with interstitial lung markings
genetic: Biallelic pathogenic variants in AP3D1 gene confirmed by molecular testing
other: Electron microscopy of platelets showing absent dense bodies
Histopathology showing granulomatous inflammation in bowel biopsies

distinguishingFeatures: Mutations in AP3B1 gene instead of AP3D1

redFlags: Severe bleeding episodes disproportionate to platelet count
Progressive pulmonary fibrosis with respiratory compromise
Development of granulomatous colitis or inflammatory bowel disease symptoms
references: Huizing M, et al. Hermansky-Pudlak syndrome: mutations, clinical and molecular genetics. Mol Genet Metab. 2004.
Wei ML. Hermansky-Pudlak syndrome: a disease of protein trafficking and organelle function. Pigment Cell Res. 2006.
